## Loading R package

Load sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility and catchment R packages into RStudio environment using the code chunk below

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, MCI, ggstatsplot) 
```

```{r}
data(shopping1)
data(shopping2)
```

```{r}
shopping1_adj <- shopping1 %>%
  filter(weekday != 3 & 
         holiday != 1 &
         survey != "pretest")
```

```{r}
ijmatrix <- ijmatrix.create(shopping1_adj,
                            "resid_code",
                            "POS",
                            "POS_expen")
```

```{r}
ijmatrix_dist <- ijmatrix %>%
  left_join(shopping2, 
            by = join_by(interaction == route))
```
